decision: Calibrated reserved-slot greedy OOV preserves the 1,000-path ranking floor; competing-set recall rises; production is unchanged.
limitations: Matched 1,000-path validation development comparison, not the 6,000-row fused baseline.
Candidate recall is membership in the ranking-competing slate (merged union reserved).
Uncalibrated greedy-OOV ranked 84.2%/91.5% after adding the same 315 OOV into the CTC slate with replacement; calibrated append-only competing-set recall is 952/1000 versus merged 944/1000.
Production vocabulary, scoring, and safety policy were not changed.
Host prefix-decoding p95 is not Android device latency.
